metadata.name: Shingle Point
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A beach landing. Assault come ashore at the waterline behind beached landing-craft hulks, with three dropships to fly over the bluff, and must cross 70 m of open sand, craters and steel hedgehogs to a concrete seawall (ladders, three gaps and two weak sections you can blow open). The Garrison holds the 16 m bluff above: four bunkers with firing slits joined by a crest trench, MG and rocket turrets with open flanks, two sentries, and the gun casemate (bomb site A). Get up through the gully road, the narrow west draw, the jump pads, the far-west ladder tower or the landslide in the far east. Behind the bluff a farming village of hedgerows and an orchard hides the HQ (bomb site B) under its radar mast, and the Garrison keeps a tank and a buggy for the counter-attack.
